meshcore.min.js - third-party license notices
=============================================

`meshcore.min.js` is a vendored browser build (the WebSerial subset) used by
/config for client-side MeshCore companion provisioning. Every bundled
component is MIT-licensed. No build toolchain ships in this repo (SPEC.md
D1 / H2): the bundle was produced once, off-repo, and committed.

Provenance
----------
Built with esbuild (--bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --minify) from a
two-export entry over @liamcottle/meshcore.js@1.13.0:

    export { default as WebSerialConnection } from "@liamcottle/meshcore.js/src/connection/web_serial_connection.js";
    export { default as TransportKeyUtil }    from "@liamcottle/meshcore.js/src/transport_key_util.js";

The Node-only serialport/net transports (nodejs_serial_connection, tcp_connection)
are deliberately excluded; @noble crypto is inlined. To regenerate:

    npm i @liamcottle/meshcore.js@1.13.0 esbuild
    esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --minify --outfile=meshcore.min.js
